notes:
Refers specifically to the outer corner of the eye (temple side). An important body-part term in Japanese, as it appears frequently in descriptions of facial expressions, cosmetics, and aging.

The expression {目尻|めじり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧ (to lower the outer corners of the eyes) describes a warm, affectionate smile or a doting expression — it is one of the most common uses of this word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {目尻|めじり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧: to smile warmly, to have a doting look
- {目尻|めじり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧しわ: crow's feet, wrinkles at the eye corners
- {目尻|めじり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to raise the outer eye corners (showing anger or sharpness)
- {目尻|めじり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧: tears at the corner of the eye

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{目頭|めがしら}→目頭：15020_megashira⟧: inner corner of the eye — the opposite location, near the nose
- まぶた: eyelid — the movable skin covering the eye
- ⟦{目元|めもと}→目元：23407_memoto⟧: area around the eyes — a broader term for the eye area in general

definitions.explanation: the outer corner of the eye, near the temple; the area where the upper and lower eyelids meet on the side away from the nose

examples.english: There are wrinkles at the corners of the eyes.

examples.japanese: {目尻|めじり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げて→下げる：00807_sageru⟧⟦{笑|わら}った→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: She smiled with the corners of her eyes lowered.

examples.japanese: {目尻|めじり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧アイライン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: If you draw eyeliner at the outer corners, your eyes look bigger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{感動|かんどう}して→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧{目尻|めじり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浮|う}かべていた→浮かべる：13314_ukaberu⟧。
examples.english: He was so moved that tears welled up at the corners of his eyes.
